Class AppointmentDAO

java.lang.Object
aparicio.dao.AppointmentDAO
public abstract class AppointmentDAO extends Object
This class is used to Create, Read, Update, or Delete appointments from the database.

    • addAppointment

      public static void addAppointment(String title, String descrip, String location, String type, LocalDateTime startDtTm, LocalDateTime endDtTm, int customerId, int userId, int contactId)
      This method is called when an appointment needs to be created in the database. It takes arguments to create an appointment and saves to the database.
      Parameters:
      title - the appointment title
      descrip - the appointment description
      location - the appointment location
      type - the appointment type
      startDtTm - the appointment start date time
      endDtTm - the appointment end date time
      customerId - the appointment customer ID
      userId - the appointment user ID
      contactId - the appointment contact ID

    • getAllAppointments

      public static javafx.collections.ObservableList<Appointment> getAllAppointments()

    • getAppntByCustID

      public static javafx.collections.ObservableList<Appointment> getAppntByCustID(int customId, int appntId)
      This method is called when a list of appointments needs to be created. It requests a list of all available appointments in the database that match a customer ID, excluding the appointment ID that is passed as an argument.
      Parameters:
      customId - the customer ID to match
      appntId - the appointment ID to exclude
      Returns:
      a list of appointments matching customer ID and excluding appointment ID

    • getAppntByCustID

      public static javafx.collections.ObservableList<Appointment> getAppntByCustID(int customId)
      This method is called when a list of appointments needs to be created. It requests a list of all available appointments in the database that match a customer ID. It is an overload method from the previous method.
      Parameters:
      customId - the customer ID to match
      Returns:
      a list of appointments matching customer ID
